Name: Prettier Spouse Rooms
Author: Louplex
Description:
[size=5][center]✦ Prettier Spouse Rooms ✦[/center][/size]
[size=3]Overhaul of Spouse Rooms - more clutter and lorefriendly atmospheric decoration[/size]

[size=3]Fitting my Mod [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19423]Prettier Interior[/url][size=3] (｡• ᵕ •｡)[/size]
[size=3]There are two Variants - Original and Empty. Empty has some furniture removed, who loves decorating can add thier own.[/size]
[size=3]The Variants are toggable via config in the Modfolder (set true to show and false to hide)[/size]
[size=3]or via [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config Menu[/url][size=3].﻿ [/size]
[size=2]May add an option to toggle the variants individually for each character in the future.

[/size][b]fixed seb's room in 1.0.2[/b]

[size=3]﻿Download via Mod Manager or manually.[/size]
[size=3]If manually, drop in 'Mods' Folder using SMAPI.[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3] needed.[/size]
